title: Asiad: Alas Men succumb to Indonesia in 4
summary: Alas Pilipinas Men succumbed to Indonesia in four sets, 23-25, 26-24, 22-25, 21-25, in the classification round of the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026, Thursday at Park Arena Komaki.
